component.name: Steam Library Manager
component.summary: The modern Depressurizer alternative for Linux — organize your Steam library like a pro

description.p: Steam Library Manager (SLM) is a powerful, Linux-native tool for organizing large Steam game libraries. Built as the modern alternative to Depressurizer with features Steam itself doesn't offer.
Smart Collections & Auto-Categorization

ul.li: Smart Collections with AND/OR/NOT logic — filter combinations Steam can't do

17 AutoCat types: Tags, Genre, Publisher, Developer, Franchise, Platform, User Score, Playtime, Playtime (HLTB), Features, VR Support, Release Year, Language, Steam Deck, Achievements, Curator, PEGI Age Rating
Hybrid Rule Groups with saveable templates and presets

description.p: Data Enrichment & Integration

ul.li: Steam Curator recommendations with overlap scoring
Steam Store metadata, review scores, and PEGI ratings

description.p: External Games

ul.li: 8 platform parsers: Heroic (Epic/GOG/Amazon), Lutris, Bottles, itch.io, Flatpak, and ROM emulation with 16 emulators
Add non-Steam games to your library with one click

description.p: Import, Export & Cloud Sync

ul.li: Cloud sync with conflict detection and automatic backups
Export to VDF, CSV, JSON, and Smart Collections
Database backup and restore with rotation
Profile system to save and restore complete configurations

description.p: Security & Performance

ul.li: Secure login via QR code or password with keyring + AES-GCM token storage
Fast startup with progressive loading — UI visible in under 3 seconds
AppImage self-update with atomic replace and rollback

description.p: Fully multilingual (English + German) with zero hardcoded strings.

screenshot.caption: Game details with ProtonDB, Steam Deck status, HLTB times, and collection overview
Smart Collections editor with AND/OR/NOT logic and live preview
Auto-Categorize dialog with 17 category types and saveable presets

description.p: Critical fix: metadata edits now actually visible to Steam. A latent bug caused metadata edits to be written into a parallel section of appinfo.vdf that Steam ignored - users saw changes in SLM but never in the Steam Library. Edits now land in the path Steam actually reads, with internally consistent SHA-1 hashes so Steam accepts the file.

New robustness layers against Steam's CDN-driven appinfo.vdf rewrites: auto-reapply on every SLM start, immediate VDF flush on save (no more lost edits on crash), and a live file watcher that re-applies modifications when Steam overwrites the file while SLM is running.

Complete External Games Overhaul. Smart Emulator Detection reads game directories directly from emulator config files (Eden, Citron, Ryujinx, Cemu, Dolphin, Azahar, RetroArch, PPSSPP, melonDS, DOSBox). Hardcoded ROM search paths removed. New Settings tab "Emulators" with custom game dirs and per-system default-emulator picker. Non-Steam shortcuts from shortcuts.vdf now appear in the main library with their tags as categories - bidirectional sync writes changes back to both shortcuts.vdf and cloud-storage so Steam shows the collections after a restart. Manual SteamGridDB search in the cover picker. DB Schema v12.
AppImage now bundles libxcb-cursor.so.0, fixing the Qt 6.5+ xcb plugin crash on Linux Mint 21.3 / Ubuntu 22.04 (GitHub #13).
Statistics Dashboard Phase 3: Playtime, Ratings and Comparison tabs. Schema v11 with platform playtime (windows/linux/mac/deck) from Steam API, HLTB rounding fix, fully translated chart labels.
Statistics Dashboard Phase 1+2: QPainter-based chart engine (donut and bar charts), Overview, Genre, Platform and Achievements tabs, MetricCard widget, Trophy Wall, playtime persistence, Schema v10.

i18n mega-cleanup (120+ duplicate keys removed, common.json grew from 31 to 76 keys), Steam and SteamGridDB API keys migrated to system keyring, Steam Store rate-limiting with 429 backoff, all docs reworked.

Fixed false-positive Steam-running detection: stale steam.pipe FIFOs are now recognized via O_WRONLY|O_NONBLOCK + ENXIO, instead of triggering on a leftover pipe from a previous Steam session (GitHub #12).
Flatpak: Steam-running detection now works inside the sandbox via the steam.pipe named FIFO. Added missing Flatpak filesystem permissions for Steam compatdata.
Fixed four broken cross-references introduced by an earlier refactor (GitHub #11).
Fixed first-run crash on fresh installs (GitHub #10).
PEGI rating fallback chain (Steam local, Steam US, HTML scrape), auto-enrich for newly added games, Flatpak manifest completed for Flathub submission.
Fixed crash on games with numeric developer/publisher fields in appinfo.vdf (e.g. Cherry Tree Comedy Club). Reported by an AUR user.
Documentation and changelog updates.
Packaging fix: the database schema SQL is now included in the wheel build.
Smart Collection resilience improvements, curator integration fixes, and a round of code cleanup.
Date handling now uses UTC consistently (calendar.timegm instead of timezone-dependent datetime.timestamp), fixing CI failures on UTC runners.
Security hardening pass.
Unified StartupWMClass across all .desktop files to match the Wayland app_id, fixing Cairo Dock and other docks not recognizing the app window.
AppImage self-update now refreshes the desktop entry so the launcher points to the correct binary. Simplified AppImage filename to a version-free form.
Steam Deck responsive UI, Library Auto-Sync, and multi-format packaging (.deb, .rpm, tar.gz).
Module rename from src/ to steam_library_manager/ for PEP 423 compliance. No functional changes.
Initial stable release with 17 AutoCat types, Smart Collections, 8 external game parsers, cloud sync, and full English + German UI.
